title: Codegen eval question bank
description: A versioned bank of typed codegen-eval cases (D1). additionalProperties:false mirrors the repo's schema discipline.

bank_version.description: Bump when the case set grows/changes; provenance for the report.

prompt_version.description: Provenance: the codegen prompt version (clip-agnostic / clip=None hash) the bank was authored against. Informational; per-fixture prompt_version is the real staleness signal.

case_id.description: Stable slug clip-shape-class-N; the fixture key.

clip_id.description: Must be a key of canned.CLIPS (enforced by test_question_bank_conforms_to_schema).

distance.description: Paraphrase distance for the per-distance report cut (D5). Optional; defaults n/a.

question.description: Mirrors the route's MAX_QUERY_TEXT_LEN (500). A static JSON Schema cannot import server.MAX_QUERY_TEXT_LEN; a pytest asserts this literal equals it (the drift guard).

answer.description: Ground truth for grounded cases; null for ungrounded.
